name: César Barreto
detail: Former Minister of Finance; stated that an emergency wealth tax is "el peor impuesto", complex to audit, and causes capital flight.

name: Óscar Orué
detail: Viceministro de Tributación (SET / DNIT); rejected wealth tax proposals arguing unconstitutionality, double taxation and lack of economic feasibility.

name: Basilio Núñez
detail: Diputado / Senador (ANR - Honor Colorado); led rejection of wealth tax in Diputados arguing it penalises job creators and duplicates existing taxes.

name: Tadeo Rojas
detail: Diputado (ANR - Honor Colorado); rejected wealth tax in Diputados as unconstitutional and warned it would frighten foreign investment.

name: Celso Kennedy
detail: Diputado (PLRA - Caaguazú); voted against wealth tax stating it would be harmful and not the right time for taxing large wealth.

name: Édgar Acosta
detail: Diputado (PLRA - Central); voted to archive wealth tax bill stating that while debate on large wealth is valid, the proposal was not appropriate.

name: FEPRINCO
detail: Federación de la Producción, la Industria y el Comercio; primary business confederation of Paraguay, emphatically rejected wealth taxes and tax increases.

name: Juana Larrea
detail: Leader of OTEP-SN; presented the educational emergency bill, but her quoted statement focused solely on educational infrastructure and biosecurity without mentioning the wealth tax.
